text:
ben_cs: FYI Lagshore reported p99 spikes on the embeddings endpoint starting ~08:10 UTC. They say it coincides with a nightly batch job.
ben_cs: top-line: p50 stable, p95 ~120ms -> p95 ~420ms, p99 up to 2.1s for ~30m window. They attached tracer screenshots.
kai_sre: thanks, can you paste the exact request patterns / sample payload? any throttles/errors in the logs?
ben_cs: sample payload (redacted):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{"model":"embed-lite-v2","input":["...large list ~400 items..."]}
```
ben_cs: they usually send batched embeds (~200-400 items) every 30m from a single subnet. No auth errors. No billing alerts.
lina_infra: initial thought: noisy neighbor / big-batch blocking GPU queues -> KV cache pressure. Any per-tenant queue depth increases?
kai_sre: pulling metrics now — seeing a correlated increase in per-tenant actor time for tenant:lagshore between 08:05-08:40. Queue depth spikes + one job hitting 100% CPU on the host pool.
kai_sre: also seeing higher cache miss ratio for model embed-lite-v2 on hosts serving lagshore. Miss ratio goes from ~3% -> ~28% during the window.
ben_cs: customer asks for a workaround: can we add them to an allowlist to avoid soft throttles? they'd prefer guaranteed reservation while they work on batching.
lin a_infra: typo above (lina). lina_infra: we shouldn't add allowlist that bypasses backpressure without reservation. Options: 1) grant short reservation (1h) on dedicated slot, 2) increase per-tenant soft limit, 3) temporary rate limit on the noisy source IP to smooth bursts.
sam_pm: they'd accept a short reservation for tonight's window, but prefer a fix on their side long-term.
kai_sre: recommended immediate steps: a) create a 1-hour ephemeral reservation for lagshore to isolate traffic, b) add a transient per-tenant max-batch-size override (cap at 128) via routing policy, c) ask customer to switch to streaming/flush smaller batches.
kai_sre: I can push routing policy change + reservation. Will coordinate with infra.
deploy-bot: config-change: routing-policy update queued by kai_sre — change-id rc-175432-ephemeral.
lina_infra: I'll provision reservation slot rsv-ld-175432 for 1h starting now. Also adding a CDN-level IP throttle rule to smooth bursts from their subnet.
ben_cs: sending instructions to Lagshore: please try 1) reduce batch to <=128, 2) enable streaming in SDK, 3) retry/backoff on 429/503. Sample curl we sent:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-lite-v2","input":["... up to 128 items ..."]}'
```
ben_cs: also asked them for the job schedule so we can monitor the next run.
kai_sre: monitoring: p99 dropping back to ~300ms after reservation applied, cache miss ratio back to ~6% on the isolates. I'll leave alerting on for next 3 windows.
lina_infra: added temporary annotation to the reservation: "customer_mitigation: batch cap + reservation". Will remove in 1h.
sam_pm: thanks — will follow up with customer to confirm whether they want a longer reservation or change their ingestion pattern.
ben_cs: action items: 1) SRE/Infra keep watch for 2 more runs, 2) CS confirm whether they want a longer reserved slot, 3) PM follow up on SDK streaming guidance.
kai_sre: if regression repeats outside batch windows, escalate and we'll run host heap/IO dig. For now looks like noisy neighbor batch job. :thumbsup:
ben_cs: closing here unless anyone sees extra anomalies.
